title: P0 Pharmacophore Validation
description: Validation benchmark: assess pharmacophore model quality by measuring ROC-AUC on a known active/decoy dataset.

pdb_id.description: PDB ID of the reference structure used to derive the pharmacophore.

auc_threshold.description: Minimum ROC-AUC for the pharmacophore model to PASS validation. AUC > 0.75 = discriminating model.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
